description: Search Superfund (CERCLA/SEMS) sites by location or NPL listing status. Returns site name, EPA site ID, NPL status (listed/not listed/proposed), cleanup status, coordinates, and county FIPS code. Accepts either state/city/ZIP or latitude+longitude+radius for proximity searches. Use for "are there Superfund sites near X" questions.

latitude.description: Latitude for proximity search (use with longitude and radius_miles)

limit.description: Maximum number of sites to return (1–200)

longitude.description: Longitude for proximity search (use with latitude and radius_miles)

npl_status.description: Filter by NPL (National Priorities List) status: listed=final NPL, not-listed=not on NPL, proposed=proposed for listing, all=include all

radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles from the given coordinates. Required when using latitude+longitude.

state.description: 2-letter US state abbreviation to filter sites

name: epa_search_superfund

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_location_filter`: No location filter (state, city, zip_code, or latitude+longitude) was provided. `radius_required`: Latitude and longitude were provided without radius_miles. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.
Recovery hint when no sites are found. Absent when sites are returned.

items.description: Superfund site record with location, NPL status, and cleanup status

nplStatus.description: NPL status code: NPL=listed, N=not listed, P=proposed

totalCount.description: Number of sites returned (may be less than available if limit applied)

title: Search Superfund Sites
